name: Nishiizu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nishiizu town emblem in blue, light blue and orange: blue and light blue stylised waves with an orange sun.
history: Municipal flag of Nishiizu, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 May 2005.
